To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have created a new large-scale dataset for news articles, and we have developed a novel CNN architecture for image captioning, source detection, and geolocation of news.

we propose a novel deep learning approach that is suitable for a wide range of image annotation tasks, including source detection, image retrieval and geolocation of news articles, and that we present a new dataset for news articles with associated images, text and GPS coordinates.

1) Deep Neural Network architectures are well-suited for the task of article illustration; 2) the use of textual features in conjunction with visual features improves the performance in the tasks of source detection and geolocation; 3) the use of a new loss function, which is tailored to the task of geolocation, leads to a significant performance improvement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new Deep Learning architectures for the annotation of images and text in news articles and their application to the geolocation of articles.
the development of novel methods for the analysis of news articles, which is a very important task with applications to many domains including journalism, marketing, politics and public opinion.
the problem of automatic image annotation for news articles, and more broadly with the problem of image-text matching.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed CNN architecture is able to learn from a large dataset of news articles and images, and to extract relevant information for a variety of tasks.
our approach is able to perform well in a wide range of tasks, including source detection, image retrieval and article geolocation, which are all relevant for news article annotation.
the results obtained with our proposed methods, although not the best in terms of accuracy, are very competitive, and in many cases outperform state-of-the-art approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an adaptive deep CNN architecture for multiple tasks, and a new dataset for the news domain, which we believe to be a very challenging but promising area to explore.
we are proposing a new dataset and an architecture for image and text processing that are able to deal with loosely related textual descriptions of images.
we have built a novel dataset, proposed a novel architecture for multi-tasking, and proposed a novel loss function.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed CNN architecture can be easily adapted for different tasks and that it is possible to train it on a large dataset of news articles to achieve state-of-the-art performance in several tasks.
the proposed CNN architectures can be used for various tasks and that the BreakingNews dataset is a good benchmark for the domain of news article illustration.
the use of deep learning techniques in the news domain can be very fruitful, even when the data at hand is very heterogeneous and noisy.
